name: What services does an interior painting contractor provide?

mainEntity.name: What services does an interior painting contractor provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior painting contractor handles all aspects of painting your home's indoor spaces. This typically includes surface preparation like cleaning, patching, and sanding; protecting furniture and flooring; applying primer and paint; and a final clean-up. They can assist with color consultation, material selection, and executing various finishes. Contractors ensure a professional, durable result and manage the project from start to finish, saving homeowners time and effort.
acceptedAnswer.description: An interior painting contractor offers services including surface preparation, paint application, clean-up, and project management for your home's indoor spaces.
